fix(config): a payload input is the daemon's, so no config can redeclare the session, file or setting the bar's own acts read (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.5e0)

The bundled default authored the payload inputs (session.id, project_dir,
config_path, every *.effective, term.cols, ...) by spreading them into its
variables, so any config file could redeclare one: `{{ .session.id }}`,
copySession and a plugin `run` then named another session.

The rows now sit beneath the parsed default instead of in it, so every
config reads them and no parsed source declares one. The loader's one
ownership check (plugin scopes) also owns the payload inputs, and refuses a
file's declaration of one, top-level or as a segment var. Synthesis no
longer supplies inputs; it only checks that its reads resolve.

Fixtures, docs and examples drop their redundant declarations; the test
floor carries the payload rows, as production does.

chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.218.1

## [1.218.1](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.218.0...v1.218.1) (2026-11-12)

### Bug Fixes

* **renderer:** a view hands its checked SessionId to its registry and its click URLs, so no config can redeclare which session a bar reads or writes (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.k4k) ([#721](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/721)) ([f654b90](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/f654b902297dc4e6fa4e12fa108c517e21d7a838))
